title: Working While Young
text:
Many teenagers now look for a part-time job while they are still at school. Some work in cafés, shops or supermarkets at weekends. They often earn their own money, which helps them learn how to manage a budget. However, some experts worry that long working hours can make it harder to keep up with homework.

Volunteering is another option for young people who want experience without a salary. Volunteers may help at animal shelters, hospitals or local charities. Many employers and universities value this kind of work because it shows commitment. In the end, the best choice depends on each student's goals and free time.

questions.text: According to the first paragraph, where do some teenagers work?
According to the second paragraph, where may volunteers help?
options: At animal shelters, hospitals or local charities

questions.text: Why might employers and universities value volunteering?
options: Because it pays a high salary
Because it takes place only at weekends

questions.text: What is the writer's most likely view about choosing between work and volunteering?
options: Every student should always choose a paid job
Volunteering is useless for young people
The right choice depends on personal goals and free time
Teenagers should never work while at school

paragraph_translations: Muitos adolescentes procuram agora um emprego de meio período enquanto ainda estão na escola. Alguns trabalham em cafés, lojas ou supermercados nos fins de semana. Muitas vezes ganham o seu próprio dinheiro, o que os ajuda a aprender a gerir um orçamento. No entanto, alguns especialistas preocupam-se com o facto de longas horas de trabalho dificultarem o acompanhamento dos trabalhos de casa.

O voluntariado é outra opção para jovens que querem ganhar experiência sem receber salário. Os voluntários podem ajudar em abrigos de animais, hospitais ou instituições de caridade locais. Muitos empregadores e universidades valorizam este tipo de trabalho porque demonstra compromisso. No fim, a melhor escolha depende dos objetivos e do tempo livre de cada estudante.
